text_block_list.text:
It's the evening, and Бива Хаяхидэ and
I have
just finished buying some training
supplies. We're
on our way home,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm? It looks like something's going on
over
there...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
A raffle, huh? Didn't we get something
that
looked like a raffle ticket from the
store?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Since we have one, why don't you give it
a—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Get out there and win a big one, Hayahide!

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You want me to go up there?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's not that! I just... hadn't considered
going
myself.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the one watching things
unfold, not
the one participating in the
actual event...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Did you always let Brian take the spotlight?

text_block_list.text:
Well, yes... She was always so sweet
when she won
something.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Back when she was still quiet and shy,
the only
time she would get excited and
yell aloud was
when she won something.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Well, today, it's your turn to get excited.

text_block_list.text:
Um... I'd hate to disappoint you, but I
don't think
that'll be happening...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ gathers her courage,
walks up to
the raffle spinner, and gives
the handle a crank.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...What?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I won the grand prize?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I-indeed...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine. I'm just still in shock...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The odds seem so impossible. There
must be 300
balls in the machine, and of
those, there can't be
many for the grand
prize—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: That's right! There's only one ball for the grand prize!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: We beat 300-to-1 odds on our first try?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I-I guess...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But wow, a voucher for a hot spring
vacation...
It'd be nice to go once things
calm down.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm sorry! This is your prize too, so of
course
you're free to invite whoever
you'd like. I'm not
sure why I assumed it
would be me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What was I thinking? I guess I must still
be in
shock.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: I don't mind if you want to use it for yourself.

text_block_list.text:
What?! You're all right letting me have
it?! Hm...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
All right, how's this? After the Twinkle
Series is
over, we can give more thought
as to which one
of us should use it and
how.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And if we both happen to be free...
Well, we can
cross that bridge when we
get to it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yay! I won something!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hehe! I can't believe I actually won—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Yes, well, now I can certainly
see how one
might get a little excited
about winning first
prize.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We won this with that ticket we got at
the
training supply store, so...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I think it's only fair if we split it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Of course! But only if you promise not to
tell
anyone about my little outburst
here.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Ah, so it's a bribe of sorts.

text_block_list.text:
N-no! Just... please don't let anyone
know.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If Brian were to find out I was acting like
a little
kid over some raffle... Ugh, the
whole thing would
be far too
embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, this is... a lot of carrots. Well, I
guess I
won't need to buy any for a
while.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Since I have so many, I'd like to give you
some as
a small token of my gratitude
for all your hard
work!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: And what about Ticket and Taishin over there?

text_block_list.text:
You read my mind. I was planning to
share some
with them too.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Ticket! Taishin! Over here!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Thank youuu!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Look out, Trainer. Make sure she
doesn't
knock you over when she comes
flying over he—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Crash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! Are you two okay?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yay!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Yes, well, winning third prize is
quite a
feat.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What? I only get a pack of tissues?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: It just wasn't your lucky day.

text_block_list.text: I... guess not. But I did learn something.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Brian used to be crushed when she didn't
win. I
thought she was adorable
whenever she wilted
like that.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But now I understand how disappointing
it
actually feels not to win anything.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And that's how we end up sharing a
whole bushel
of carrots with Winning
Ticket and Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We decide to split the prize, so we each
have half
a carrot.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I promise to take her secret to the grave,
and we
enjoy the hamburger steak
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I console Бива Хаяхидэ as we resume
our walk
back home...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Бива Хаяхидэ puts away
the
voucher very carefully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
